integrity: Standalone integer checker is included; no external dependencies or independent certification are claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact Fourier nullities when the rim length is divisible by three, endpoint projection norms, and spectra outside labelled wheel graphs are not determined. The general result is established by a proof; finite checks are corroborative, and independent mathematical validation has not occurred. The Benjamin--Yerger manuscript carries an internal 2004 date but its exact earliest public posting date was not verified.
title: Sharp dyadic Walsh gaps and exact Hilbert deconvolution norms for wheel spanning trees
